# #2253: Patch: daily quests for Stinkyscape, Radiant upgrades and position switches, and every set that ships keeps a set quest
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

One kind of daily quest asks a player to play cards of a given set. Each older set has one, but the newest set, Stinkyscape, has none. Two of the game's signature moves are never asked for either: making cards Radiant mid-game, and switching a unit between Attack and Defense. The game already counts both in every finished game. Once this is built the quest pool gains “Play 8 Stinkyscape cards” and one quest each for Radiant upgrades and position switches, with targets and payouts set the way the pool's other quests are. A check also makes the next set's release add its own set quest, so the gap can't come back when Training Grounds ships.

## Why

- `crates/server/quests.json` holds 19 quests. Its set quests are `core-8`, `classic-8`, `classic-plus-8`, `meditative-8` and `meditative-plus-8`. Stinkyscape ships (`SHIPPED_SETS`, `crates/engine/src/wire/catalog_types.rs:287-294`; v0.5.0) and has no quest.
- Nothing catches the gap: `quests::problems` (`crates/server/src/economy/quests.rs:89-145`) refuses a set quest for a set that does not ship, but not a shipped set that lacks one. The Training Grounds set (#2204) ships next and would miss its quest the same way.
- SPEC §1's pillars name the two combat axes (Attack and Defense position) and say “upgrading cards mid-game is a core resource loop”. Every game record already counts both per seat: `SeatSummary.position_switches` and `radiant_upgrades` (`crates/engine/src/wire/stats.rs:131-137`, R1256000). Yet `QuestGoal` (`quests.rs:44-65`) has no goal that reads them, and `GameTally` (`:196-200`) holds only plays, traps fired and attacks.

## Proposal

- Add `stinkyscape-8`, “Play 8 Stinkyscape cards”, with the same target and Jlore as the other set quests.
- Add two goal kinds, `radiantUpgrades` and `positionSwitches`, counted into `GameTally` from the seat's `SeatSummary` fields (a record without them counts 0). Add one quest for each to `quests.json`, inside `QUEST_JLORE_MIN..=QUEST_JLORE_MAX` and consistent with the rule that a harder quest pays more, which `problems()` enforces.
- Add a test in `quests.rs` that every set in `SHIPPED_SETS` has at least one `playSetCards` quest, so shipping a set without one fails.
- Add zh-CN titles for the three new quests (`QuestsPanel.tsx` shows `t(quest.title)`).
- SPEC §14.9 names the new goals. If the builder has to decide what counts as a switch or an upgrade for a quest (for example, “as the record counts it, R1256000”), that is a ruling in this issue's block, with its paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`.

## Where it lands

- `crates/server/quests.json`, `crates/server/src/economy/quests.rs` and its tests
- `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`
- SPEC §14.9; R1304000, R1256000

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `quests::shipped()` parses the pool with the three new quests.
- [ ] A test fails when a set in `SHIPPED_SETS` has no `playSetCards` quest, and passes on the new pool.
- [ ] A seat summary with `radiantUpgrades: 2` moves a `radiantUpgrades` quest by 2; `positionSwitches` works the same way; a summary without the fields moves neither.
- [ ] A finished game through the reward hook moves a held quest of each new kind (an existing quest store test, extended).
- [ ] zh-CN holds the three titles; `cargo test -p jackioh-server` passes, and `cargo jackioh spec check` too if a ruling is added.

## Size and risks

Small to medium: the data file, one server module and its tests, the dictionary, and perhaps one ruling note. Low risk: older records count 0, and the pool's own check still enforces that a harder quest pays more. No card, engine or client logic changes.
